A deck upgrade should provide a seamless transition between your home's indoor living areas and outdoor landscape. Featured here is a modern multi-tier deck with durable composite planking, strong steel support beams, integrated hot tub seating, and clean horizontal cable railings that keep views open. For homeowners planning outdoor living projects in Bellevue, proper footings, structural framing, and weatherproofing are essential for long-term durability. Iconiq Construction designs and builds custom outdoor spaces tailored to your home. Explore your options by reaching out to our team today.
